parts.text: worktree 已就位（4432d357，与客测部署版本一致）。现在实施模板修复：companyName 加宽 197.55→217pt（单行放下测试值，右缘 394.25pt 不碰底图「统一社会信用代码」标签 399.4pt）；bankName 收窄 193→155pt（不再压「预售资金监管账户」标签）并加高 30.45→45pt（两行折行完整显示）。先提取两个 AlternateContent 块确认内部结构：

tool_input.command:
$xml = Get-Content 'D:\repository\szfc-v3-be-wt-bug6315\zhi3-presale\src\main\resources\templates\presale-permit-template.docx' -Raw -Encoding UTF8 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
# docx is binary; unzip worktree template fresh
$tmp = "$env:TEMP\bug6315-fix"; if (Test-Path $tmp) { Remove-Item $tmp -Recurse -Force }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path "$tmp\x" | Out-Null
Copy-Item 'D:\repository\szfc-v3-be-wt-bug6315\zhi3-presale\src\main\resources\templates\presale-permit-template.docx' "$tmp\t.zip"
Expand-Archive "$tmp\t.zip" "$tmp\x" -Force
$xml = Get-Content "$tmp\x\word\document.xml" -Raw -Encoding UTF8
foreach ($ph in @('companyName','bankName')) {
  $i = $xml.IndexOf("`${$ph}")
  # find enclosing mc:AlternateContent
  $start = $xml.LastIndexOf('<mc:AlternateContent>', $i)
  $end = $xml.IndexOf('</mc:AlternateContent>', $i) + '</mc:AlternateContent>'.Length
  $block = $xml.Substring($start, $end-$start)
  Write-Output "=== $ph block len=$($block.Length) ==="
  # show all size-ish attrs
  [regex]::Matches($block, '<wp:extent[^>]*/>|<a:ext cx="\d+" cy="\d+"/>|style="[^"]*(width|height)[^"]*"|<wp14:sizeRelH[^>]*>.*?</wp14:sizeRelH>|<wp14:sizeRelV[^>]*>.*?</wp14:sizeRelV>') | ForEach-Object { $_.Value } | Select-Object -First 12
}
Set-Content "$tmp\document.xml.bak" $xml -Encoding UTF8 -NoNewline
